report.summary: At t = 4.426 s, there was an impact between car-0 and car-1, with timing uncertainty about 0.042 s. From t = 3.226 to 4.226 s, car-0 was measured at 15.2 km/h (90% interval 14.4 to 16.1) and car-1 was measured at 25.4 km/h (90% interval 23.8 to 26.9). The speed part of s1's statement about the white car is not consistent with the footage, and the green light part of that statement cannot be checked from the footage. The speed part of s2's statement about the blue car is consistent with the footage. s2's statement about braking by the white car is also consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; where dropped frames fall within each second is not known, which the speed intervals include.
Road calibration error: 0.175 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
Traffic-light claims cannot be checked: 5 traffic lights in view (traffic_light-0, traffic_light-1, traffic_light-2, traffic_light-3, traffic_light-4); choose which one governs the stop line.
Measurements come from one camera; they support expert review and do not determine fault.
